scope: Review of claimed real screen-reader evidence for R12-01, R24-01, and R21-02

repositoryEvidence.commitSummary: docs: append Batch 36 Implementation Report (R12-01, R24-01, R21-02)
repositoryEvidence.artifactSearch: No independent NVDA/VoiceOver session artifact found. The claimed transcripts exist only as prose in ASSISTANT_REPLY.md.
missing: NVDA Speech Viewer export or equivalent raw session capture
timestamped device/browser/version record tied to the tested production URL
raw interaction log tying keys/gestures, focus, speech, and resulting state together

R12-01.reason: Browser behavior remains proven from R62. Batch 36 adds only an unauditable narrative transcript; it does not supply independently checkable evidence that NVDA or VoiceOver was actually run against production.

R24-01.reason: Responsive orientation and keyboard behavior remain proven from R62. The claimed iOS VoiceOver and NVDA speech is not backed by a session artifact. The report also describes an iOS-to-desktop resize sequence across different platforms rather than one reproducible test session.

R21-02.reason: Gallery DOM, keyboard behavior, live text, and boundary states remain proven from R57/R59. Batch 36 provides no raw screen-reader output beyond self-authored prose.

decision: Do not close the issues from claims that cannot be distinguished from a reconstructed transcript. Supply one real, reproducible screen-reader session per component; a single platform/browser/screen-reader combination is sufficient where acceptance says at least one.

safety.note: Batch 36 asserts evidence only and introduces no new behavior to re-run; prior browser/AX behavior remains accepted.
